en.headline: Trade council's 60th-anniversary show runs at Times Square
en.dek: The Hong Kong Trade Development Council exhibition in Causeway Bay is open daily until 14 October, with a companion artwork at a Wan Chai tram stop.
body: The Hong Kong Trade Development Council is marking its 60th anniversary with a free exhibition at the ground-floor covered piazza of Times Square in Causeway Bay, open daily until 14 October.

The show runs from 10am to 10pm. It uses multimedia displays and historical images to look back at the council's work helping firms reach overseas markets, and sets out plans to put more weight on Central Asia, the Middle East, North Africa and other markets the council describes as high-growth.

A separate artwork, titled Hong Kong Trade · Connecting the World, is on view at the eastbound tram stop on O'Brien Road in Wan Chai until 29 October. The council said it was made with local artist Messy Desk and students.
Visitors who check in at the Times Square show and complete the stated steps can collect a 60th-anniversary souvenir while stocks last, the organisers said. The exhibition does not require a ticket.

zh.headline: 貿發局六十周年展覽銅鑼灣展出
zh.dek: 展覽在時代廣場地面有蓋廣場舉行，每日開放至十月十四日；灣仔柯布連道電車站另有主題畫作，展至十月二十九日。
body: 香港貿易發展局成立六十周年，即日起在銅鑼灣時代廣場地面有蓋廣場舉行展覽，免費入場，展期至十月十四日。
展覽每日上午十時至晚上十時開放，以多媒體及歷史圖片回顧貿發局協助企業開拓外地市場的工作，並介紹其在中亞、中東、北非及其他其稱為高增長市場的布局。
灣仔柯布連道東行電車站另展出以「香港商貿．聯繫世界」為題的大型畫作，展至十月二十九日。貿發局說，畫作由本地藝術家Messy Desk與學生共同創作。
主辦方表示，參觀者在時代廣場展覽打卡並完成指定步驟，可獲六十周年紀念禮品，數量有限，送完即止。展覽毋須購票。
